youtube.description:
Sing Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes with Robo and Pip, and learn your body parts! Pip touches each part while Robo asks "Where is your head?", then it is your turn to touch it too and light up a star. Sing the song together, then sing it again faster, play the "What's this?" freeze game, and touch your eyes, ears, mouth and nose in the bonus round, then a quick point-to-it quiz.

Body parts: head, shoulders, knees, toes, then eyes, ears, mouth and nose.

Sing at home: touch each part as you sing it, go faster each time, and play freeze: stop, point to a part and ask "What's this?". Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes is a traditional public-domain rhyme, sung to a traditional public-domain tune.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
